common_symptoms: heart murmur, rapid heart rate, throbbing of the jugular veins, swelling along the surface of the abdomen
drugs: diuretics, digitalis and digoxin, ACE inhibitors, vasodilators, beta-adrenergic blocking drugs
diagnosis_challenges: swelling or effusion, lack of specific symptoms
treatment_challenges: regulating arrhythmias and blood pressure, enhancing blood flow, decreasing fluid volume in lungs, abdomen, and chest cavity
